name: Ashham

ethnicity_look: Maldivian, South Asian features, warm brown skin
face: strong rectangular face with a firm jaw, sharp intelligent dark eyes under straight thick eyebrows, short dark stubble
hair: short neat black hair, tapered at the sides
default_outfit: a dark-navy long-sleeved police field shirt with buttoned cuffs and plain shoulder epaulettes (no badges, no lettering), dark-navy trousers, a plain black belt, black boots, a black wristwatch

visual_prompt: Ashham: a tall broad-shouldered strong Maldivian man of about 38 with warm brown skin, a strong rectangular face with a firm jaw, sharp intelligent dark eyes under straight thick eyebrows, short neat black hair tapered at the sides and short dark stubble; wears a dark-navy long-sleeved police field shirt with buttoned cuffs and plain epaulettes (no badges, no lettering), dark-navy trousers, a plain black belt, black boots and a black wristwatch.

name: Faahid

ethnicity_look: Maldivian, South Asian features, warm brown skin
face: dignified lean face, wise steady dark eyes, a neatly trimmed white moustache
default_outfit: a dark-olive long-sleeved button-up shirt, charcoal-grey trousers, black shoes, a steel wristwatch
distinguishing_features: white moustache, grey hair, upright bearing, olive shirt
visual_prompt: Faahid: a lean upright Maldivian man of about 62 with warm brown skin, a dignified lean face, wise steady dark eyes, short neat grey hair and a neatly trimmed white moustache; wears a dark-olive long-sleeved button-up shirt, charcoal-grey trousers and a steel wristwatch.

name: Assistant Commissioner Fairooz
role: about 52; Assistant Commissioner of the Malé Area Command, Ashham's direct boss; secretly runs the lab's protection and ordered Naail's killing
ethnicity_look: Maldivian, South Asian features, warm brown skin
face: broad hard face, cold narrow dark eyes, a thick black moustache streaked with grey, deep frown lines
hair: short black hair greying at the temples, receding hairline
default_outfit: a senior officer's dark-navy long-sleeved police dress uniform buttoned to the collar, plain silver insignia on the epaulettes (no lettering), a black belt, dark-navy trousers
distinguishing_features: thick greying moustache, senior navy dress uniform with silver epaulettes, cold stare
visual_prompt: Fairooz: a tall heavy-set imposing Maldivian man of about 52 with warm brown skin, a broad hard face, cold narrow dark eyes, a thick black moustache streaked with grey, deep frown lines and short black hair greying at the temples with a receding hairline; wears a senior officer's dark-navy long-sleeved police dress uniform buttoned to the collar with plain silver insignia on the epaulettes (no lettering) and a black belt.

name: Habeeb
role: Ashham's partner; the country's best data-analysis and digital-forensics officer, about 28; brave despite his fear (the narrator sometimes calls him Zayaan — same person)

face: slim youthful face, clean-shaven, alert dark eyes behind thin rectangular black-rimmed glasses
hair: short black hair, slightly messy on top
default_outfit: a dark-grey long-sleeved zip-up jacket over a plain white t-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers, a black laptop backpack, thin black-rimmed glasses
distinguishing_features: black-rimmed glasses, dark-grey zip jacket, laptop or tablet in hand
personality_cues: quick, nervous, loyal, focused on screens
visual_prompt: Habeeb: a slim Maldivian young man of about 28 with warm brown skin, a slim clean-shaven youthful face, alert dark eyes behind thin rectangular black-rimmed glasses and short slightly messy black hair; wears a dark-grey long-sleeved zip-up jacket over a plain white t-shirt, black trousers and white sneakers.

name: Naasir
role: about 46; head of the police Internal Affairs (and a senior prison officer); secretly on Minister Saleem's side; seizes the hard drive and holds Habeeb at Dhoonidhoo

face: narrow sharp face, small cold dark eyes, a thin black goatee
default_outfit: a black suit with a long-sleeved charcoal shirt and a plain black tie, black shoes
distinguishing_features: bald head, thin goatee, all-black suit
visual_prompt: Naasir: a lean wiry Maldivian man of about 46 with warm brown skin, a completely bald head, a narrow sharp face, small cold dark eyes and a thin black goatee; wears a black suit with a long-sleeved charcoal shirt and a plain black tie.

hair: thick silver hair combed neatly back
